context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss through negotiation tactics
purpose: Teach: 可決/敗訴/先制/紳士/長所/民法/所持/負債

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 明日の取締役会で例の買収案が可決されるか、正直まだ読めません。
lines.en: I honestly can't predict yet whether tomorrow's board will approve the acquisition proposal.
lines.style: Mid-forties executive speaking with respectful but worried tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 君の長所は冷静さだ。だが交渉では、時に先制パンチを打たないと主導権は握れんよ。
lines.en: Your strength is composure. But in negotiations, sometimes you must strike first to seize the initiative.
lines.style: Retired executive speaking warmly with gravelly elder mentor wisdom.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 先制ですか…ただ、相手は紳士協定を盾にしてきそうで、強く出にくいんです。
lines.en: Strike first, you say... but the other side will hide behind a gentleman's agreement, making it hard to push.
lines.style: Hesitant younger boss seeking guidance from his senior carefully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 紳士的に見せながら、刃は隠しておけばいい。民法の条文にも、味方につけられる箇所があるはずだ。
lines.en: Look gentlemanly on the surface, but keep the blade hidden. Even civil law has clauses you can leverage.
lines.style: Old executive chuckling with sly tactical wisdom and confidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 実は先方、かなりの負債を抱えていて、こちらが敗訴した過去案件まで持ち出してくるかもしれません。
lines.en: Actually the other party is carrying substantial debts, and may even bring up a past case where we lost in court.
lines.style: Younger boss confiding sensitive details in lowered serious voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 敗訴した経験こそ財産だ。同じ轍を踏まぬよう、先方が手元に所持している資料を先に読み解きたまえ。
lines.en: Losing a case is itself an asset. To avoid the same rut, decipher the documents they have on hand before they do.
lines.style: Mentor offering paradoxical wisdom with calm reassuring authority.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なるほど、負債の構造を逆手に取るわけですね。少し光が見えてきました。
lines.en: I see, so we turn the debt structure to our advantage. I'm starting to see some light here.
lines.style: Younger boss brightening with renewed confidence and gratitude.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: そうだ。可決させたければ、相手に勝った気にさせてやれ。それが本物の紳士の戦い方さ。
lines.en: Precisely. If you want it passed, let the other side feel they won. That's how a true gentleman fights.
lines.style: Elder closing with warm conspiratorial smile and final lesson.
